rules: GRANT ROLE team_nimbus_writer TO team_nimbus_rw
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE `team-nimbus` TO team_nimbus_writer
GRANT MATCH {*} ON GRAPH `team-nimbus` TO team_nimbus_writer
GRANT WRITE ON GRAPH `team-nimbus` TO team_nimbus_writer
GRANT NAME MANAGEMENT ON DATABASE `team-nimbus` TO team_nimbus_writer
GRANT ROLE team_nimbus_reader TO team_nimbus_ro
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE `team-nimbus` TO team_nimbus_reader
GRANT MATCH {*} ON GRAPH `team-nimbus` TO team_nimbus_reader

isolation.note: Neo4j RBAC: the reader role holds ACCESS and MATCH {*} on this tenant's database and commons only; the writer role adds WRITE and NAME MANAGEMENT. Another tenant's database is not accessible at all.
